title: Design and Operation of Buried Channel Charge-Coupled Devices

passages.locator: pp. 7–10, Introduction, CCD operation, Figure 6 and reference 1
passages.note: Fairchild’s study cites Walden et al. and independently measures the effects of different buried-channel structures on images from 500-element linear devices. Greater isolation from the silicon–oxide interface improves transfer and resolution after many shifts.
